facts.fact: 她冲进餐厅拍台索要 Mr. Jack。
facts.anchor: “Mr. Jack, I need him now!” My hands slam on the podium.

facts.fact: 她的坏运气撞碎了花瓶，接待员根本不知道谁是 Mr. Jack。
facts.anchor: “Who–who is Mr. Jack?” she asks in a panic, attempting without fruition to save the destroyed vase.

facts.fact: 地址指向一座真正的豪宅。
facts.anchor: Pulling up to the address, I find an actual mansion.

facts.fact: 两个保镖对讲机核对后放行。
facts.anchor: They whisper back and forth for a bit, one even speaking into a radio, the other shrugging in response.

facts.fact: 通知：先搜身，他一小时内用晚餐。
facts.anchor: “Yeah, park here. We need to search you first. He will be ready for his dinner within the hour.”

facts.fact: 搜出她那件染满鼻血的借来的衬衫。
facts.anchor: as he holds up the borrowed shirt my nose bled all over with a raised brow.

facts.fact: 刀具卷袋被摊在引擎盖上盘查。
facts.anchor: He unrolls it on the hood of my car. He eyes them warily. “You need all of this for one meal?”

facts.fact: 放行条件：你会被全程盯着。
facts.anchor: just know you have eyes on you.

facts.fact: 她在磨刀器旁找到了以为自己丢了的肉桂瓶。
facts.anchor: I spot my bottle of cinnamon tucked in with the sharpener.

facts.fact: 厨房豪华胜过她进过的任何餐厅。
facts.anchor: This kitchen is amazing. Better than any restaurant I have stepped foot into.

facts.fact: 她做多了——一人份的量太难拿捏。
她来不及撒最后一把肉桂就被拖走了。
facts.anchor: But he’s already dragging me away before I can add the dash of cinnamon to the top.

facts.fact: 警告：呈上晚餐就退出，别靠近他。
facts.anchor: “Present it to him and then come back out. Don’t get too close to him,” the man warns
And then he is pushing me through the doorway.
